flag.control: icon-only button to right of lifecycle icons
flag.state: aria-pressed; orange when selected; same autosave field

saveIndicator.owner: pure global projection of all Action/catalog drafts and busy/unknown/recovery/conflicts/errors
saveIndicator.presentation: one header icon with accessible label/title; spinner for saving; reduced-motion fallback; actual inline recovery/error controls remain

sections: always visible semantic sections, no collapsible details in Action inspector

defer.controls: one coordinated date + time pair, one persisted deferUntil proposal
defer.initialDateOnly: first date selection sets explicit client timezone 09:00
defer.clear: clearing date releases defer; empty/partial time does not default09 after user intent
defer.raw: perAction raw date/time state preserved through refresh/navigation/newer acknowledgment/unknown
defer.conversion: pure existing strict timezone resolver; DST ambiguous/nonexistent rejected; render/zonechange never saves or changes instant

global icon covers offscreen Action/catalog dirty/error/unknown
